title: Venus Flytrap Horror
description: A man in a dark coat stands inside a derelict greenhouse holding a long pole with a glowing tip toward a giant monstrous Venus flytrap. In the foreground, a woman in a green trench coat stands at a table with a vintage radio and a coffee cup, watching the scene. The floor is wet, an exit sign glows red in the background, and heavy rain streaks down the glass walls.
prompt: A tense cinematic scene inside an old abandoned greenhouse at night during heavy rain. A man in a long coat stands in the middle ground holding a long pole with a glowing red tip towards a giant monstrous carnivorous plant with teeth and hanging prey. In the foreground, a woman in a trench coat stands near a table with a vintage radio and coffee cup, observing. Red exit sign glowing in the background, wet reflective floor, dramatic volumetric lighting, moody and unsettling atmosphere.
